title: Entity
description: A single collected tenant object (user, group, application, role, etc.) normalized into the canonical snapshot model. Engineering plan section 7 (minimum data contracts) and section 8.2 (canonical record rules: missing vs. explicit null are distinct, arrays use explicit semantics).

entityId.description: Stable source ID from the origin system (e.g. a Graph or ARM object ID). Immutable across snapshots of the same object -- comparison (section 10.3) correlates on this field.

tenantScope.description: Tenant/cloud scope identifier this entity was collected from. Comparison rejects cross-tenant inputs by default (section 10.3) using this field.

displayName.description: Tenant-controlled display name. Explicit null (not an absent property) when the source system genuinely has no display name for this entity type -- missing vs. null are distinct per section 8.2.

collectedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp. Culture-sensitive date formatting is forbidden project-wide (section 8.2).

sourceEndpoint.description: The exact allowlisted endpoint/API this entity was collected from (section 7.3), for provenance.

properties.description: Collector-declared allowlisted fields for this entity type. Structure varies per entityType; validated by the owning collector's own field-allowlist, not by this generic envelope (section 8.4: collectors use field allowlists and do not persist full API responses by default).

redacted.description: Whether this record has already had export-time redaction applied. Evaluation always uses unredacted evidence (section 10.2) -- this flag exists so a redacted record is never mistaken for a full one during re-evaluation.
